summary: Tested Moulin Comics per-language editorial content override feature (FR/EN/ES). Backend: 9/9 pytest passed (public GET, admin PUT hero/en, footer/es, maison/en with blocks, invalid lang, invalid section, unauthenticated, empty override unset, products regression). Frontend: full flow OK via Playwright — admin login, lang switcher (fr/en/es data-testid), lang-note visible in non-FR, FR placeholders shown as grey hints in EN inputs, save-hero produces 'Traduction EN enregistrée' toast, EN eyebrow persists after reload, FR value untouched by EN edits, salons tab shows villes-shared-note in EN and ville-0 editor in FR, maison EN block override displays on public /?lang=en, footer ES override displays on public /?lang=es. No EN leak on FR/ES public pages. /shop still renders products (regression OK, 13+ products via API).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1000 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline; consider splitting content/auth/products/import/payments into routers for maintainability.
SiteContent.jsx defines helper `frImg` after the JSX return of the component (line 247). Works due to function hoisting inside the component body but is stylistically confusing; move it above return.

_merge_content only merges top-level keys and does not deep-merge nested `en`/`es` overrides — currently fine because per-lang objects are read as-is on the client, but note that empty string/list overrides are stripped server-side (update_content_lang cleans body), which is correct behaviour.
seed_data_creation: Test overrides created in site_content.home: hero.en (TEST_EN eyebrow + 'Your next UI collectible / is right here' title), maison.en.blocks[0].title='TEST_EN VO first UI', footer.es.description='TEST_ES Tienda de comics UI …'. Main agent may want to overwrite with clean demo copy.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All admin editorial per-language flows work. Backend endpoints: PUT /api/admin/content/{section} (FR base) and PUT /api/admin/content/{section}/{lang} (en|es only). Public GET /api/content returns merged doc with nested {en,es} sub-objects for each section. Localized rendering handled client-side (Home.jsx localized() helper + Footer.jsx base[lang]). Villes marquee intentionally shared across all languages.
